attributes.geo_place: approximate place found by OSM geocoding (P262): {label 'approximate place (OSM)', precision street|postcode|city|region, disclaimer, attribution, direction forward|reverse, provider, lat, lon, display_name, osm_url, address}
attributes.geo_precision: precision level of an OSM geocoding answer: street, postcode, city or region (P262 cond 6)
attributes.geo_label: fixed label of a geocoding answer: 'approximate place (OSM)' (P262 cond 6)
attributes.geo_disclaimer: fixed caveat of a geocoding answer: 'an address is not proof of residence' (P262 cond 6)
attributes.geo_attribution: data attribution every report must carry for OSM places: '(c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0)'
attributes.geo_provider: geocoder that answered: nominatim (OSMF) or photon (komoot fallback)
attributes.geo_display_name: display name of the approximate OSM place (street, district, city, state, postcode, country)
attributes.geo_osm_url: OpenStreetMap object page of the matched place (evidence; map links come from pivots_geo_image)
attributes.geo_address: address parts of the approximate OSM place: {road, house_number, suburb, city, state, state_code, postcode, country, country_code}
attributes.geo_export_allowed: False when the place may locate a natural person: kept in the case and left out of STIX/MISP exports unless the analyst opts in (P262 cond 6)
attributes.ela_summary: terminal line of the error level analysis: 'ELA map in the HTML report (heuristic, not proof)' (P264 cond 5)
attributes.ela_metrics: numeric error-level metrics of a JPEG re-saved at q90 (heuristic, not proof of tampering): {mean, max, std, p99, frac_ge_16, region_ratio, hot_regions, width, height, resave_quality, jpeg_quality_estimate}
attributes.ela_map_png: contrast-stretched ELA map as a data:image/png URI for the HTML report only (never a file outside the case, never printed in the terminal)
attributes.identity_signals: identity signals of a typed person seed inside the case's own documents (P273): {name_found, occurrences, confidence, criterion, signals, alert, layout, nearest_cpf_masked, typed_cpf {masked, found_in_document, next_to_name}}; CPFs masked only
attributes.identity_windows: bounded (<= 200 characters) excerpts around each occurrence of the typed name, CPFs masked (***.XXX.XXX-**), with the nearest masked CPF of that occurrence
attributes.ua_category: user-agent class from the offline table: browser, bot, automation, scanner, benign_scanner, empty or unknown (P317)
attributes.ua_parsed: parsed user agent (P317): {browser, browser_version, os, os_version, device, tool, bad_crawler_match, exploit_probe, truncated}
attributes.ua_risk_ceiling: highest risk a user agent alone may give an IP: always LOW (user agents are trivially spoofed, P317 cond 4)
attributes.card_bin_info: binlist.net facts of a card BIN (P318): {scheme, type, brand, prepaid, country {alpha2, name, numeric, currency}, bank {name, url, phone, city}, number {length, luhn}}
attributes.card_scheme: card scheme of a BIN (visa, mastercard, amex, elo...)
attributes.card_type: card type of a BIN (debit or credit)
attributes.card_issuer: issuing bank name of a BIN (binlist.net; often empty)
attributes.imei_tac: 8-digit Type Allocation Code of an IMEI (the only part ever sent to a TAC lookup, P319 cond 3)
attributes.imei_masked: IMEI shown as TAC + '*******' (personal identifier: the serial is never printed)
attributes.device_info: device model of a TAC (P319): {name, brand, model, models, manufacturer, device_type, os, os_family, sim_slots, nettech, aliases}

tags.bot: user agent of a non-human agent (crawler, link preview, monitoring); not a verdict
tags.automation: user agent of an HTTP library or automation client; not a verdict
tags.heuristic: heuristic output (for example error level analysis): context only, never proof and never scored
tags.no_cross_case_index: result holds name-CPF pairs: excluded from the sightings index (even as HMAC) and from STIX/MISP exports (P273 cond 5)
